summary: All pages remain visually intact across desktop and mobile with perfect accessibility, best-practices, and SEO scores. Performance on / dipped slightly but stays above 85; /projects/note-structurer (83) and /projects/screenshot-to-primevue (79) continue to sit below the 85 threshold, with the latter's LCP improving meaningfully from ~5.1 s to ~4.6 s.

Clinical Note Structurer project page with a green 'Evals: 10/10 passing' badge, two-column visit-note / structured-result demo panel, synthetic-sample buttons, an amber disclaimer banner, and expandable JSON / architecture accordion sections, all clean on desktop and mobile.
